text:
Tess Sales: Quick handoff to CS for CinderEdge (trial tenant: cinder-edge-trial). Customer exploring hosted trial but flagged potential regulatory need for private deployment later. Renewal horizon ~42 days. Signup notes: https://drive.redwood/cinderedge-brief. Need owners for provisioning, compliance pre-check, and a short enablement runbook. Any immediate blockers?

Farah CS: Thanks @Tess. I can take onboarding + renewal watch. Plan: 1) short async welcome + 15m demo 2) C360 notes + follow-ups 3) 25d check-in cadence.
- Risk: elevated if they require private deploy before renewal. Capture compliance Qs on kickoff.

Liam Support: I'll spin up a hosted trial to get them started and open ticket SUP-7001 for provisioning. Please confirm org id, desired region, and if they want sample data preloaded.

Tess Sales: Org id: cinder-9001. Region preference: eu-west-1. Sample dataset: cinder_sample_orders.csv (shared). They also asked for a timeline estimate for private (VPC) deploy.

Liam Support: Running provisioning now. Script we use:
```
POST /ops/provision
{
  "tenant":"cinder-edge-trial",
  "org_id":"cinder-9001",
  "env":"trial",
  "region":"eu-west-1"
}
```
I'll update SUP-7001 with logs.

Diego Eng: Heads-up: if they later move to private deploy, lead time ~3-4 weeks (audit + infra). For trial, recommend model `redwood/gpt-stream-lite` and set autoscale min to 0.4 GPU-equivalent to avoid demo cold starts. I'll monitor KV cache and add a per-tenant latency alert.

Farah CS: Expected demo QPS ~1.0 peak, avg 0.2, typical session <= 180 tokens. Diego that config sounds good. I'll tell the customer the private deploy ETA estimate but mark as tentative.

Liam Support: Provision complete . Endpoint: https://cinder-edge-trial.api.redwood/v1. API key masked `rk_test_cinder_xxx`. SUP-7001 updated: "provision OK". Smoke tests passed and sample data uploaded.

Diego Eng: Pushed autoscale tweak and a tiny latency dashboard. Patch REF-INF-CINDER-12. Also added an alert: latency_p95 > 800ms -> page on-call.

Farah CS: I'll prepare a 10m walkthrough recording and a 1-page runbook covering: how to call API, example prompts, where logs appear, and the private deployment timeline. I'll add compliance questions to the kickoff agenda.

Tess Sales: Scheduling kickoff with customer for Thu 2025-03-27 09:00 CET. I'll include billing contact and their security lead.

NotifyBot: Calendar event created: CinderEdge - Trial Kickoff (2025-03-27T09:00:00+01:00).

Farah CS: Owners & next steps:
- Liam: provisioning & support triage (SUP-7001)  done (see ticket)
- Diego: autoscale + latency dashboard + alert  done
- Farah: walkthrough + C360 notes + 25d renewal check-in
- Tess: customer invites + billing & security contacts

Tess Sales: Renewal risk = "watch" but escalate to "high" if customer requires private deploy before renewal. Will surface billing/security contacts on the kickoff invite.

Liam Support: Closing SUP-7001 for the hosted trial; will reopen for any post-kickoff issues or private deploy requests. Added runbook excerpt and smoke logs to the ticket.

Farah CS: Captured immediate customer asks: demo recording, clearer prompt templates, SSO/SSO timeline, and private deploy ETA. I'll log these in C360 and add action items.

Diego Eng: If they signals for private deploy, please tag infra-review and security-review early so we don't push the timeline.

Farah CS: Will do. I'll also add a renewal owner and reminder for 25 days out.

Tess Sales: Thanks everyone  closing the pass. :thumbsup:
